RF_I.pdf.content:
--- Page 7 ---
A network interface is a device's connection to one particular network.
lo        → Loopback interface
eth0      → Ethernet interface
wlan0     → Wi-Fi interface
An IP address is assigned to a network interface.
--- Page 8 ---
[ROUTER]───┤
               Interface eth1 — 10.0.0.1/30 (WAN to ISP)
               │
               Interface eth0 — 192.168.1.1/24 (LAN)
               │
